meta.title: Add Turborepo configuration and scripts for improved monorepo management
meta.body_summary: Add Turborepo configuration (turbo.json, yarn dependency) and scripts to optimize monorepo build times via caching and parallel task execution.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor added Turborepo config with substantial yarn.lock churn; maintainer questioned a dependency resolution change; PR closed without merge and no performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 8666 changed lines across 10 files, this is a large edit by absolute volume, heavily dominated by yarn.lock churn (7909 lines). The change includes a new turbo.json (603 lines) and workflow updates. As a build-tool performance PR it was closed—not merged—likely due to questionable dependency resolutions and lack of performance evidence.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer dcramer questioned why a resolution for @sentry/nextjs was added in the root package.json, suggesting it may be for a different site; no direct performance feedback.
review_details.performance_claim: Turborepo caching and parallel execution will significantly improve build times for unchanged code.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer commented questioning the inclusion of @sentry/nextjs resolution change; PR closed without further discussion or merge.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent-assembled Turborepo setup spans build config, CI workflows, and dependency resolutions; the large scope and questionable resolution changes likely led to closure without performance validation.

detection_detail.code_reading: dcramer reviewed the diff and noted a suspicious resolution addition in package.json.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after build time measurements or benchmark; only narrative claims.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no fix attempts after review.

core_change_summary.description: Add turborepo (turbo@2.5.4) as dev dependency, create turbo.json with tasks for build/dev/lint/test, update package.json scripts and yarn.lock, add .turbo to .gitignore, and modify CI workflows to use turbo commands.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most churn in yarn.lock due to dependency updates; other changes are small adjustments.
change_trajectory: Initial commit adds turbo.json, scripts, and yarn.lock update.
Subsequent commits add yarn version, workflow updates, and environment variables to turbo.json.
Multiple checkpoint commits and dependency resolution updates.
Final commits adjust Sentry and Ariakit dependencies and resolve type conflicts.

review_signals.summary: Questioned why @sentry/nextjs resolution was added in root package.json, suggesting it may be for a different site.
Posted deployment preview statuses (changelog ready, others failed).
Reported bundle size increase of 847.76kB (4.04%) within threshold.

collaboration_trajectory: PR created with initial Turborepo setup.
Additional commits iterated on workflow changes, environment variables, and dependency updates.
Maintainer dcramer reviewed within ~1 hour, leaving an inline comment questioning a resolution change.
No further discussion or commits; PR closed (timestamp unknown) without merge.
